DESIGN PROTOTYPE
Legal entity federation / Design edition 04

Desired state is not observed state.

Separate policy permission, physical copy presence and destination acknowledgement.

Operator states

StateMeaningOperator action
BlockedCurrent source policy denies a never-authorised candidateInspect entity, geography and entitlement reason.
Placement blockedNo store satisfies the synthetic entity country policyProvision an approved country store or obtain an approved policy change.
Queued / retryNo successful acknowledgement yetCheck ingress pause, OPA and database availability.
ReplicatedRecipient-scoped live copy acknowledgedInspect fields, aggregate version and policy/placement generation.
Purge pendingRead denied; previously contacted live copy not yet removedRestore approved connectivity and reconcile; do not claim deletion.
PurgedLive projection removed and acknowledgedTrack retained history and other surfaces separately.

Pause experiment

In the global monitor, pause London ingress, revoke LE-GB-02 from a Singapore owner record, and inspect the pending queue. Business reads deny access immediately under the current owner check. Resume to complete the live purge. Pause is an application ingress control, not a killed database process.

Operational boundaries

No automatic regional failover, no active-active ownership and no home migration is implemented. A global synthetic admin snapshot can inspect all demo records; production operators must use authorised regional views. Unreachable stores must be displayed as unknown, not as zero copies.

HAND OFF TO ENGINEERING

Build this component

A focused prompt with scope, contracts and acceptance criteria.

Read the full prompt
Design edition 04: 30 synthetic bank legal entities (UK 3, Asia 8, Americas 3, MENAT 5, rest of Europe 11), mapped independently to three physical PoC stores in Singapore, London and New York. Asia assumes one entity in each of eight countries. All names, mappings and country rules are illustrative, not legal advice or bank policy. Preserve global customer identity; master key is (owner_entity_id, global_customer_id); projection key additionally includes destination_entity_id. Sharing a store or global ID does not share entitlements. OPA evaluates entity grants AND resolved physical country restrictions, with deny override. The downloadable implementation is a single Python/FastAPI harness, three independent CockroachDB single nodes, three OPA engines, outbox polling and OpenTelemetry. The hosted monitor is a labelled browser simulation. Local HA, Java regional services, CDC/Kafka, distributed fencing and signed permits are production extension work. The original v3 catalog planner does not execute migrations. Edition 08 adds an isolated executable relocation slice and optional fourth store; see Entity relocation. Automatic geography failover remains prohibited.

Build incident runbooks around policy state versus observed copy state. Add actual database, OPA and network fault injection after the Compose integration gate. Preserve unknown states and purge-pending evidence. Test that a healthy but prohibited store never becomes a failover target.
